text:
They call him king and blindfold his eyes, and expect him to divine and not see; they give him a scepter swayed by wind, a crown of reeds and thorns.


With such ceremonies and spoils Judea's realm desires its king: let him command with a cane, possess pain, and blindly suffer its rage.


But the Lord, whose just rule is enclosed in a well-armed iron rod, reveals crowned mercy in his love.


He buys peace for his people with his war, spends the points and sword upon himself; learn from Him, you who govern the earth.

translation.title: They Call Him King and Blindfold His Eyes
